data.one_liner: Lightweight Dart logger with automatic caller info, structured logs, and rotating file writers.
data.what_it_does: Chirp provides a zero‑configuration logger that automatically includes file, line, and class information. It supports structured logging, multiple writers, lazy message construction, and extensible formatting.
use_when: Need quick, structured logging in Dart or Flutter
Want automatic caller info without boilerplate
Require rotating file writers for long‑running services
Need lazy logging to avoid expensive string interpolation
avoid_when: You need a full UI logging framework with visual dashboards
Your app already uses a comprehensive logging solution like log4dart or a custom logger
strengths: Zero configuration, works out of the box
Extensible writers and formatters, including rotating file support
Lazy logging APIs to avoid unnecessary work
Automatic caller info and instance tracking
weaknesses: No built‑in UI or visual log viewer
Not a full‑featured logging framework with metrics or dashboards
Requires Dart/Flutter environment, not a general logging library for all languages
